title: UpdateJobToDbJobs
description: A conditional UpdateItem of one row of the DynamoDB jobs table: the key (job_id) and the attributes the write changes. A number or string sets the attribute; null removes it (a released lease). The writes made are: generating (status, response_id, project_id and, if known, thread_ts), finishing (status, finishing_started_at), completed (status), failed (status, error; by job-failed only), release of the claim lease (claimed_at: null) and release of the finishing lease (finishing_started_at: null). The conditions on the current status and leases are not part of this payload.

job_id.description: Huddle path: the Slack file ID. Manual path: lowercase hex SHA-256 (architecture §6).

response_id.description: OpenAI background response ID (indexed by a GSI).

finishing_started_at.description: Unix seconds when the process-issues lease started; null releases it.

claimed_at.description: Null releases the process-summary claim lease.
